search_text: published ZDI-11-057 ZDI-CAN-417 (0Day) Hewlett-Packard Data Protector Cell Manager Service Authentication Bypass Vulnerability 2011-02-07 CVE-2011-0921 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2011-0921 10.0 AV:N/AC:L/Au:N/C:C/I:C/A:C ['Hewlett-Packard'] ['Data Protector'] This vulnerability allows an attacker to execute remote code on vulnerable installations of Hewlett-Packard Data Protector. User interaction is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the Cell Manager Service which listens by default on a random TCP port. The crs.exe process fails to properly validate supplied username, domain, and hostname credentials. A remote attacker can leverage this flaw to execute code on all Data Protector clients. ['2009-01-26 - Vulnerability reported to vendor', '2011-02-07 - Coordinated public release of advisory'] Anonymous https://www.zerodayinitiative.com/advisories/ZDI-11-057/
title: (0Day) Hewlett-Packard Data Protector Cell Manager Service Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows an attacker to execute remote code on vulnerable installations of Hewlett-Packard Data Protector. User interaction is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the Cell Manager Service which listens by default on a random TCP port. The crs.exe process fails to properly validate supplied username, domain, and hostname credentials. A remote attacker can leverage this flaw to execute code on all Data Protector clients.
